# 2021 Elections

There were 2 elections held in Jersey in 2021.

- **[St John Connétable By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2021#e46)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[St Clement Connétable By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2021#e47)**

  1 seat · 2 candidates · 28% turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

* * *

* * *

## 2021 St John Connétable By-Election

By-Election following the removal of Chris Taylor by the Royal Court (1 seat), 31st March 2021.

**[Andy Jehan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/andy-jehan) was elected as Connétable of St John in 2021 unopposed**.

#### Sources

- [https://www.bailiwickexpress.com/jsy/news/andy-jehan-becomes-constable-elect-st-john/](https://www.bailiwickexpress.com/jsy/news/andy-jehan-becomes-constable-elect-st-john/)

* * *

## 2021 St Clement Connétable By-Election

By-Election following the death of [Len Norman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/len-norman) (1 seat), 28th July 2021.

**[Marcus Troy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/marcus-troy) was elected as Connétable of St Clement in 2021**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Marcus Troy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/marcus-troy)** |  | 1,185 | 77% |
| 2 | [Simon Brée](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-bree) |  | 350 | 22.8% |

1,538 votes (inc. 3 spoilt papers)

5,500 registered voters

28% turnout

#### Sources

- [https://www.vote.je/new-st-clement-connetable-elected/](https://www.vote.je/new-st-clement-connetable-elected/)
